messages:
jess-csm: Heads up  Summit onboarding traffic spiked overnight, want a 15m triage to add a short-term spend cushion before the QBR? :wave:
kai-finops: Saw it in billing. Baseline ~1.5k tokens/day -> ~30k for the cohort. If sustained, est +$3.2k/mo. Recommend temporary daily cushion + staggered alerts. :bar_chart:
omar-ops: Fast options: tenant daily cushion (config) + enable batching on batch endpoint. Cushion buys time while we tune caching.
lucy-qa: If we add cushion, need error/notice contract for clients. Prefer warn headers then soft 429. I can run quick regressions.
quota-bot: Policy draft: summit-cushion-4132109876 created. Hooks: #customer-success, kai-finops@redwood.internal.
vio-customer: Thanks  can you enable batching on the batch-embed endpoint? We'll push top-8 prompts + expected concurrency by EOD.
jess-csm: Proposed quick config: daily_cushion=35000; alerts at 50/80/95%; soft_throttle_at=90% with one-click override for demos. I'll add a short QBR appendix and notify the customer.
kai-finops: I'll add conservative/likely/upside spend scenarios into the deck and mark renewal risk as "monitoring - low-medium" for now.
omar-ops: We can roll the cushion today. Soft-throttle will return 429 + JSON {"code":"soft_throttle","remaining":N} and header X-Soft-Throttle. Feature-flag gate on tenant.
jess-csm: Great. Lucy + Omar, please drop a 4-point test checklist and the response contract into the shared QBR doc (https://redwood.internal/qbrs/summit). Aim to close before Thursday so QBR has the mitigation slide. :thumbsup:
